$comment: Sprint 03 controller-owned patch evidence record. NOT part of the Sprint 00 shared common schemas; validated through src/evidence/patch/schema.mjs using the shared Sprint-00 validation engine (supported keyword subset only). All fields are controller-derived git facts. validationResults is the Sprint 04 hook surface (test/secret-scan results attach here).
title: LCIM V2 controller-owned patch evidence record

evidenceId.$comment: CONTEXTUAL evidence observation identity: unique per controller observation, independent of patch content. Two observations of identical patch bytes MUST carry distinct evidenceIds and distinct record paths. Controller-generated; never worker-supplied.

patchId.$comment: CONTENT identity: lcim_patch_ + first 32 hex chars of patchHash (sha256 of the canonical patch bytes). Identical canonical patch bytes share one content-addressed patch artifact.

worktreeId.$comment: worktree identity the observation was collected from; binds the contextual record to the controller-owned disposable worktree

changedPaths.$comment: sorted unique repository-relative posix paths of every observed change (tracked M/A/D plus untracked files)

additions.$comment: sorted unique paths added (git status A, including untracked files the controller intent-to-adds)

deletions.$comment: sorted unique paths deleted (git status D)

patchHash.$comment: sha256 hex over the canonical patch bytes (git diff --full-index --binary --no-renames <baseSha>)

errors.$comment: stderr lines from `git diff --check <baseSha>` when clean is false

validationResults.$comment: Sprint 04 hook surface: test/secret validation results attach here; the semantic contract compiler is NOT implemented by Sprint 03
